retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a central group portrait framed by textured geometric bands and heavy, distressed display typography.
triggerTerms: group portrait with geometric side borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a group is flanked by horizontal bands of yellow and black organic patterns, set against a dark background with large, textured, slab-serif display text at the top and smaller stylized text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic window framed by graphic borders
Large textured display type dominating the upper third
High-contrast yellow patterns against dark backgrounds
Symmetrical layout with a central vertical axis
coreInvariants: Distressed, sponge-like texture inside the primary display lettering
Horizontal graphic bands with high-contrast organic squiggles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of seven people occupies the central 60% of the frame in a medium-shot portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured display text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the group portrait, and finally rest on the bottom logo/text element.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space at the top and bottom edges creates a letterbox effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Orange (Graphic bands and bottom logo)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright yellow patterns and teal text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy Slab Serif and Condensed Sans
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-bold slab serif skeletons with internal distressing
Secondary text uses high-contrast condensed sans-serif
Bottom text features a custom gear-like graphic integrated into the lettering
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have a 'stamped' or 'sponged' internal texture
Bottom text includes a sunburst/gear icon replacing or surrounding a central character
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured slab for impact paired with wide-tracked serif for branding.
graphicDevices: Horizontal bands with yellow 'scribble' or 'leopard' pattern
Sunburst/Gear icon at the bottom center
Thin white underline beneath specific letters

preserve: Textured fill of the main title
Wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Clean, solid fills for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif skeleton needed for the main title.
Matches the wide-tracked, small-serif feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark charcoal background with a central rectangular photo of a 1980s pop group. Flank the photo with horizontal bands featuring a dense yellow and black organic squiggle pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, uppercase slab-serif text at the top with a teal sponge-texture fill and white outline. Add wide-tracked serif text at the bottom center, integrated with a yellow gear-shaped sunburst icon.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text textured with a teal/cyan pattern?
Are there horizontal yellow patterned bands on the left and right?
Is the bottom text centered and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Density of the yellow squiggle pattern
Intensity of the sponge texture in the top text
Color of the thin outlines on the display type

avoid: Untextured solid colors for display elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teal texture is visible inside the top letters.
Verify the yellow bands have a high-contrast organic pattern.
Check that the bottom icon does not obscure the legibility of the bottom text.
Confirm the dark background frames the entire composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central group portrait with heavy textured slab-serif headers and high-contrast geometric patterned borders for a retro-pop aesthetic.
